mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.75% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.75%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate rising above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% monthly change) forces Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% monthly change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 104.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls < 104.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and non-farm payrolls declines signal severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2020-2022.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 104.5) indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2020-2022.
